Health/PostgresCdcHealthCheck.cs.reason: Health check with mockeable service dependencies

justifications.unit: Unit tests construct the real PostgresCdcHealthCheck and run CheckHealthAsync against substituted connector and position store for the healthy, connector-failure (error code only in the data) and position-store-failure (degraded) branches, covering all three lines.
justifications.guard: Guard tests assert ArgumentNullException for the null connector and position store, which the base CdcHealthCheck constructor throws; they run the constructor but not the health check body, so two of the three coverable lines.

NpgsqlReplicationClient.cs.reason: Npgsql-backed IPostgresReplicationClient (#2781): runs the SQL, opens the LogicalReplicationConnection and decodes pgoutput messages. The Npgsql replication message types have no public constructors, so decoding is only reachable with a live logical-replication server and is measured by the integration flag.

justifications.unit: Unit tests run the constructor guard and, against a refused local port, the start of GetCurrentWalLsnAsync, EnsurePublicationAsync and StreamAsync up to the failing connection; everything after a connection is established needs a live server, so the unit flag reaches only a small part of the file and the rest belongs to the integration flag.
justifications.integration: Integration tests run the real client against a PostgreSQL 17 container with wal_level=logical: the current LSN query, publication creation and detection, slot creation, the pgoutput stream and the decoding of relation, insert, default-identity update and full-image delete messages and the acknowledgement; left uncovered are the full-image and index-key update arms (their test is skipped because of the defect tracked in #2776), the no-image fallback arm of the delete switch, the end of the stream iterator, the decode catch that turns a failing row read into a DecodeFailureRecord.

PostgresCdcConnector.cs.reason: CDC connector over PostgreSQL logical replication. The Npgsql calls sit behind the internal IPostgresReplicationClient seam (#2781), so the change-event mapping, error paths, position restore and acknowledgement order are unit tested through a hand-written fake; the integration tests run the same connector over the Npgsql-backed client against a PostgreSQL container started with wal_level=logical (tests/Encina.IntegrationTests/Cdc/PostgreSql).

justifications.unit: Unit tests drive the real PostgresCdcConnector through a hand-written fake of IPostgresReplicationClient (tests/Encina.UnitTests/Cdc/PostgreSql/PostgresCdcConnectorMappingTests.cs): insert, update with and without old image, delete, relation and skipped records, a decode-failure record, a mapping failure through a throwing TimeProvider, publication setup and its failure, a client failure during streaming, cancellation, the connector resuming the client after each record (the acknowledgement itself happens in the Npgsql client and is exercised by the integration flag), position restore (saved, foreign, Left) and GetCurrentPositionAsync (valid, null, unparsable and failing LSN), so every coverable line of the file is executed; the target leaves two lines of slack for future edits.
justifications.integration: Integration tests run the real connector over NpgsqlReplicationClient against a PostgreSQL 17 container with wal_level=logical: GetCurrentPositionAsync, fresh and pre-existing slot and publication, insert, delete and default-identity update events, truncate skipping, restoring a saved position, cancellation and the publication failure; left uncovered are the null-LSN branch and the catch of GetCurrentPositionAsync (the server always answers), the decode-failure and mapping-failure branches and the in-loop cancellation exit, all of which the unit flag executes.

PostgresCdcOptions.cs.reason: Configuration POCO with defaults — no guard clauses

justifications.unit: Unit tests read every default and setter of the options POCO and its ToString, which covers all seven lines.

PostgresCdcPosition.cs.reason: Position with ToBytes/FromBytes serialization round-trip invariant and CompareTo antisymmetry

justifications.unit: Unit tests run the real PostgresCdcPosition constructor, ToBytes, FromBytes, CompareTo and ToString including the invalid-length and non-Postgres comparison branches, covering all twenty coverable lines.
justifications.guard: Guard tests assert ArgumentNullException and ArgumentException on FromBytes and CompareTo; they reach only the guard lines of those two methods, three of the twenty coverable lines.
justifications.property: Property tests run the ToBytes/FromBytes round trip and CompareTo antisymmetry over random LSNs, leaving uncovered the guard-throwing branches and ToString.

ReplicationRecord.cs.reason: Internal record types the replication client hands to the connector; compiler-generated members only

justifications.unit: Unit tests construct every record kind (relation, skipped, insert, update, delete, decode failure) and the connector maps them, which executes all the generated constructors and accessors of the file.
justifications.integration: Integration tests stream real relation, insert, update and delete messages through the Npgsql-backed client, which constructs the record kinds they decode; the decode-failure record is never produced there, so one coverable line stays uncovered.

justifications.unit: Unit tests call AddEncinaCdcPostgreSql with real service collections and resolve the registered options, connector and health check, covering all nine coverable lines.
justifications.guard: Guard tests assert the ArgumentNullException for a null services collection and a null configure action, which is two of the nine coverable lines.
